definitions.measured_liability_stack: Gross federal debt plus the OASDI 75-year open-group present-value shortfall plus Medicare's 75-year government-wide resource gap.
definitions.doom_index: Legacy data-key definition for the measured liability stack; this is not the new 0–100 Doom Index evidence score.
definitions.household_income: BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey mean after-tax income per consumer unit. The latest published mean is 2023; BLS could not publish a 2024 mean because its external tax model was not updated.
definitions.ratio: Liability stock per Census household divided by one year of BLS mean after-tax income per consumer unit; read as approximate income-years.
definitions.discretionary_income: St. Louis Fed/BLS definition: after-tax income less food at home, housing, transportation, health care, and personal insurance and pensions. The latest published benchmark is 2023 and is rounded.
definitions.annualized_unfunded_burden: Derived level real annual payment that amortizes the Social Security and Medicare 75-year present-value gaps over 75 years at the Trustees' 2.3% intermediate ultimate real interest rate. It is an economic funding benchmark, not a current legal invoice.
definitions.education_productivity: Census public-school current spending per pupil, deflated by CPI-U and compared with the equally weighted index of national-public grade-8 NAEP reading and mathematics scores. Chart values are normalized to 2003=100 for visual comparison; NAEP scores are not ratio-scale measures of knowledge, and the relationship is descriptive rather than a causal estimate of spending efficacy.
definitions.demographic_support_ratio: OASDI beneficiaries in current-payment status on June 30 per 100 people who had OASDI-covered earnings at some point during the calendar year. OASDI includes old-age, survivor, and disability beneficiaries; it is broader than pensioners.

tax_summary.method_note: Static upper-bound: applies the 31.8-point federal statutory-rate increase to positive book pretax income of U.S.-listed domestic common stocks; ignores behavioral response, foreign-source rules, credits, deductions, loss offsets, and general-equilibrium effects

summary.definition: Reduce the FY2026 unified deficit to 3 percent of GDP and reduce the combined Social Security and Medicare 75-year present-value funding gap to no more than one year of current GDP.
summary.warning: Social Security and Medicare funding gaps overlap with future unified-budget deficits. This construction combines a current-year deficit target with prospective prefunding; it must not be added again to a full 75-year unified-deficit present value. The reform shares are present-value financing sensitivities, not specified benefit cuts or independently scored policy packages.

marketcap_summary.methodology: For each ticker and calendar year, select the last non-null Sharadar DAILY marketcap observation, then sum by basket. The distraction basket is the complete GLM 5.2 score >= threshold set, including delisted names. Industrials are all SF1 U.S.A. Domestic Common Stock tickers with TICKERS.sector = Industrials, including delisted names. A ticker contributes through its final priced year only.
marketcap_summary.selection_caveat: The 2026 GLM classification and historical $1B screen are applied retrospectively; this is a historical capitalization comparison of the selected set, not a point-in-time constituent-selection backtest.

fcf_summary.methodology: Exact Doom Thesis daily ARQ replay: process filings in datekey order; retain the latest version then known for each ticker+calendardate; sum the four latest distinct quarters only when all four FCF values are present; include a ticker only during its Sharadar public pricing window. Annual values are the last daily rolling-four-quarter observation in each calendar year.
fcf_summary.spacex_note: SPCX remains in the Industrials universe. Sharadar currently has fewer than four non-null ARQ FCF quarters for SPCX, so the strict four-quarter methodology does not yet include it in aggregate FCF.

attention_summary.score_threshold_method: Zero at the 2003 baseline and 100 if the measured digital-leisure/socializing ratio doubles; clipped linearly between those anchors.
attention_summary.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics American Time Use Survey LABSTAT series; direct BLS public API with DBnomics's BLS mirror as a rate-limit fallback

games_computer_leisure_hours.label: Playing games and computer use for leisure

sports_exercise_recreation_hours.label: Participating in sports, exercise, or recreation

attention_summary.caveat: ATUS records a respondent's primary activity. Concurrent smartphone or media use during work, commuting, eating, or socializing is not captured, and the survey has no annual 2020 estimate. Television and leisure computer use are not inherently harmful; the ratio is a descriptive attention-allocation proxy, not a causal productivity estimate.

personalization_events.comparison: since product launch; not a randomized causal estimate
personalization_events.note: Meta attributed more than 24% higher Instagram time spent since Reels launched to its AI-powered discovery engine.

personalization_events.comparison: Q4 2025 ranking improvements; company-reported product measurement
personalization_events.note: Meta reported a 7% lift in organic feed and video views from ranking improvements.
Meta reported that Q4 recommendation optimizations lifted time spent on Threads by 20%.

summary.coverage_caveat: The distraction classifier covered companies that historically exceeded $1 billion market cap. Unclassified smaller companies remain in the ex-distraction cuts; the count is reported above.
summary.interpretation: GDP-deflator-adjusted revenue growth and cash-flow margin outside known distraction businesses are an observable bridge from AI investment to broad operating-company outcomes. They are not standalone causal estimates of productivity because prices, mix, acquisitions, entry, and cyclicality also move them.
summary.methodology: U.S. domestic common stocks from Sharadar TICKERS, active and delisted during their public windows. Exclude GLM 5.2 distraction scores >=70. Replay ARQ filings by datekey, retain the latest version then known for each ticker and calendardate, and sum the four latest distinct quarters. Revenue, NCFO, and FCF must all be present for the same four-quarter company cohort.
summary.sector_caveat: The primary group excludes Financial Services and Utilities because conventional free cash flow is not comparable there. The literal all-sector ex-distraction result remains in the data.

human_capital_evidence.tech_hiring_definition: SignalFire proprietary Beacon AI estimates derived from professional-profile and organization data. Its 2025 Big Tech universe contains the top 15 technology companies by market capitalization; its 2026 Tech Majors universe contains 12 named companies. The series measures employer demand and career transitions, not graduate quality alone.
human_capital_evidence.medicare_improper_payment_definition: CMS explicitly says improper payments are not a fraud measure. They include overpayments, underpayments, missing documentation, coding errors, and administrative failures.

methodology.aggregation: Available indicators are reweighted within component; component weights remain fixed; coverage and missing-input bounds are separate.
methodology.probability_warning: The research score is not a calibrated probability that the Doom regime occurs.
methodology.transform: Fixed, disclosed linear thresholds clipped to 0-100; high always means more evidence for Doom.

missing_input_sensitivity.interpretation: Bounds assign every missing or stale indicator either 0 or 100 without reweighting.

stop_status.reason: The research override is now reproducible, but historical point-in-time calibration and strategy execution conventions are incomplete.

cbo.role: Central-case reference; not assigned an invented probability density.

historical.vintage_warning: Current-vintage history; not an ALFRED real-time vintage.

productivity_escape_forecast.interpretation: Research ensemble, not a calibrated forecast probability. SPF respondent dispersion and historical frequency are diagnostics; the tail depends on the disclosed AI scenario prior.
